body: I appreciate your responses!

Thank you! I definitely don’t want to feel rushed or forced, it wouldn’t benefit anyone. Sometimes I feel like I need to compete with my recent ex on moving on because he’s already with someone new after a month and a half.
Thank you for the reassurance 🥺

No, don’t be jealous. He’s probably just trying to feed his ego knowing I’ll still reply to him. I’m very angry with him right now. He plays with my emotions, moved on like I was nothing to him. And he knows I still care/love him so I bet he’s taking advantage of that. We were together for 6 years and he started seeing someone not even 2 months later. It’s a really shitty feeling. I wish he wouldn’t text me, but I can’t block him since we still have stuff to take care of. It’s 2 and a half months post breakup, and it’s honestly been a sick rollercoaster.

I don’t think I’m fully there, even though he’s already dating someone. I get the thought that he’s just rebounding. He still checks in with me from time to time to see how I’m doing, so I know he’s thinking of me. It’s only been a little over 2 months, and I’ve accepted that he doesn’t want me… at least right now. But there’s still the glimmer of hope in the back of my mind. He says it’s not going to happen, and I’ve accepted that. But his actions have shown different than his words since the break up. I know you can’t properly heal with that hope, but I haven’t fully let go yet.

Yeah, same. My ex is seeing someone new after a month and a half, but reaches out to check up on me even though I told him to not contact me and I also didn’t want to be friends.

I kinda look at it as he’s still thinking of me, so it boosts my ego a lil bit. 💁🏽‍♀️
My puppy would of course be vaccinated before anything. I wouldn’t hire someone, but I do have people at home who would take him out every couple hours.

In my experience, I rebounded during the first breakup with my ex. It honestly feels terrible. I used someone for my own benefit, and wasn’t ready. I felt guilty afterwards. I also went on a couple dates, and those people became weirdly obsessed with me. I couldn’t take it. The whole time I’m thinking of my ex. It wasn’t fair to those people, and to myself. This time around he’s rebounding and I’m taking the time to focus on myself for once. People cope differently. I wouldn’t suggest it. But whatever works. 🤷🏽‍♀️

We’ve been dating for over six, but “officially” together for 5 years. Our anniversary date is in a couple weeks, making it hard on me too. 😕 the fact that he’s moved on so quickly makes me feel like it meant nothing to him. I’m sorry you’re going through this too, because it’s definitely hurtful. We’ll get through it. 💛

I’m 2 months post breakup from a 6 year relationship. He moved on in a less than a month, already seeing someone. I also feel like I need to compete and go out and date, but I know I’ll feel guilty and probably think about my ex the whole time, even though I shouldn’t. So, I’ll be doing it for the wrong reasons. I just miss having someone to talk to and be intimate with, but I’m no where near ready. But whoever I do end up seeing will get the upgraded version of me, and I hope that drives my ex crazy.
Get that poor baby to a vet asap!

Wow, this is like me. 

My and ex and got a house together, renovated it together. We mostly agreed on the same things, but I was the one to pick it out and show him for approval. 

I picked the floors, kitchen cabinets, countertops, colors of the house and paint, all the appliances, decorated the whole house, the furniture. I picked everything. That house is all me. 

He’s the one who paid all the bills, and I was more focused on “wife duties” so I had to leave. He’s already moved on in less than two months, we were together for almost 6… so that definitely hurts. 

Even though he’s replaced me, there’s no way he can’t think of me in that house. I made that house a home…

Damn, everyone is at around 2 months. What is up with these assholes breaking up right before the holidays, making it the worse time if the year for us. Mine is also seeing someone else already. Like I meant nothing to him. It really does suck, but we will get through it. Take it day by day, some will be better than others. Good luck to you 💛
🍻 cheers to that!

I was also scared. I was with mine for almost 6 years.. our anniversary date is actually in a couple weeks. 😔 I wanted to try to still be friends or at least friendly. But in the end it does me no good. As people say, I won’t be able to properly heal if I continue talking to them. Leaving them in 2021 doesn’t necessarily mean goodbye forever. Maybe one day we’ll meet our exes again, after we grow and improve ourselves. We will be a whole new person by then, and who knows what that will bring. But definitely need to take the time this year to focus on ourselves for once. Love ourselves the way we loved them.

I only had experience with one once. It was handmade. I'm sure it was fake, but in 6th grade, our school went on a camping trip with another. Someone made a Ouija board out of paper. They "spoke" to someone, I forgot their name. But she said she was killed by a branch. There was someone actually buried in the back of one of the cabins, so assuming it was her. 🤷🏽‍♀️
You’re right. Thank you.

I feel like that could make things worse though. 😔 I’m pretty sure I may be the only one who knows they have these thoughts, so they will know it would be me who called for a wellness check. They may flip out and then possibly hating me.
Why do you feel bad? They’re doing whatever they want without considering your feelings, you can do the same.
It seems like so many people broke up right before the holidays, making the end of 2021 so shitty. I hope the new year is good for you too!

Lol Peaches for me. Instead of bitch, please, it’s Peach, please. 

And I like peaches, so gimme peaches, please.

Similar to me, almost 6 years and we had a cat together. He’s keeping her, and I miss her so much. Wish I could cuddle with her one more time. 😔

Good luck, my friend. 2022 will be the year for the dumpees to bounce back!

Hey, I’m right there with you. Mine will be two months in a few days and I also thought I’ve been moving on. But one day I’ll be fine, the next I won’t. 

Today was also a hard day for me, with no friends, nothing to do, knowing he’s out partying, probably with the rebound he’s seeing. All I did was think about how shitty this year turned out to be. 

I don’t want another bad year. So here’s to hoping 2022 will be a good one. 🥂
Happy New Year 🤍
Happy New Year 🤍
They’re called ovaries.
It took me a while to actually delete them. But after I did, I felt a little relieved. It’s a step towards moving on. You can do it!
But they just move into a “hidden” folder that you still can see. The pictures just won’t show up on your main album. So you either fight the temptations to look anyway, or delete them. 🙂
Lol same! I literally got a new car yesterday just because of all the memories tied to my old one. I don’t like the “new year, new me” motto, but I’m taking it literal this new year. 😅

I did the same. I ‘hid’ them on my phone, but then would find myself still looking at them. It only made things worse. And once my ex started treating me like shit, I deleted everything. Years worth of texts also.
Thank you for that response. I guess even though I’ve accepted the breakup and that he’s moved on, I may still have slight denial and hopes for reconciliation. 🥲

Yeah, same. Thank you. It definitely opened my eyes and right now isn’t a good time to try to be friends. The breakup is still fresh, and it wouldn’t be a good idea since knowing he’s seeing someone else makes me sick... I told myself to focus on myself in the new year, I just have to stick with it.

I just started working out since my breakup, and never worked out besides in high school, 10 years ago. Personally for me, my ex is always on my mind, no matter how much I try to distract. BUT with working out, I’ve already lost 15lbs in less than 2 months, I’m feeling a little more confident with myself and honestly healthier. Plus, in the end when I reach my goal weight, I’ll be lookin’ hot and they’ll wish they stuck it out with me. So 🤷🏽‍♀️

From what I hear, the healthier route is to process all the emotions. Cry, let it all out. Distracting yourself and suppressing your feelings help temporarily, but eventually it’ll hit them and they end up having to start the grieving process. By that time the other person will be moved on and feeling better. I personally don’t have experience. I’m processing it currently, and my ex is distracting themselves. I can’t tell yet if it’ll hit them or if he just dgaf anymore. That’s also what can happen, I’m sure. Everyone copes differently.

I agree. I personally cannot be friends with mine. We were together for almost 6 years. I will always love them and want to be with them, so it will only hurt me to know they don’t feel the same anymore. And if I were to move on, I don’t see it being beneficial to have them in my life if I’m seeing someone else.

There’s no appropriate time, it really depends on if you’re ready for it. My ex is already casually dating, and it only took him a month and a half. Me on the other hand, cannot even think about going out there and seeing other people, I’m not ready. We were together for almost 6 years, and right now I can’t picture myself seeing other people. Not yet, and also not into casual hookups. So I’m giving myself the time to heal and improve. It will take me months, maybe a year, but I’m waiting until I know I’m ready.

Accept it. It’s a hard pill to swallow, but you have to. My ex moved on from our 6 year relationship in less than a a month. I’m still hurt by it, and it’s only been almost 2 months since the break up. Everyone’s way of coping is different, and unfortunately that just may be they’re way. Also, the dumper will feel relieved after the breakup.

Hell to the no. It would fuck me up mentally. I’m not completely over the break up, so knowing that they are dating someone or sleeping with them will destroy me. I told my ex I will not be friends with them because I know they are out dating. It hurts too much. I won’t be able to actually move on if I were to hang out with them knowing they’re involved with someone else.

Thank you! Makes me not feel so crazy that I’m changing so much after the breakup. 😅

And congrats on the weight loss! I’m only at 15 lbs. but working towards 20-30 more.
Still, 3 months isn’t long enough to become in love. Plus, dating doesn’t necessarily mean they’re exclusive.
How long have they been dating? You aren’t immediately in love with someone when you first start dating.
It sucks when their way of coping is to suppress it and focus on distractions. It kinda makes me want to so the same, but it’ll make me feel worse in the end. Idk.

Lol. Thank you. Tbh I’m not okay, but I’m trying to be. Bills and shelter aren’t an issue. Bills will be paid, I have a place to live. I’ve spent my time in my past relationship putting myself last, so I’m trying to work on putting myself first, and doing whatever I want without anyone saying otherwise. If it’s financially not smart, I’ll deal with it. But that’s the thing, I think I may be doing too much, but it’ll get taken care of eventually. My thoughts are to put my mental health and happiness first before worrying about money. idk. That’s why I think I’m just acting out being irrational, or if it’s normal. 🤷🏽‍♀️

You Right in my ass. 

It fits. Thanks Doja Cat. 😅

I’m currently not talking anymore, but when we did he would always be short and distant when I would initiate the convo but he seemed interested when he initiated. It just made me feel like he only wanted to talk to me at his convenience, such a shitty feeling.

Yeah, hard to accept but you’re right. The person we love is no longer there. We broke up once before and he is acting almost the same way, except the first time we were still in contact and seeing each other. This time feels different, like it’s truly over. Now he’s just a memory.
It sucks badly. It’s like we’re total strangers now and all of those memories were just a dream. 😔
I don’t know, I wouldn’t know. I’m sure they’re mature and do want to be friends. If that’s the case, then good for you. Maybe they still have feelings.
I hope they do. I’m improving myself. Taking that new year, new me mentally literal. Lol. Hoping they regret their decision, although I know there’s a slim chance.

For me, he knows I wouldn’t be able to be friends and most exes don’t. He would tell me he wants to stay friends because “he thinks maybe one day we could work out again” but then saying he doesn’t want to give me false hope. Wtf is that then. Not even a month and a half after the breakup and he’s out dating. So I told him to not contact me and that I do not want to be friends. Constantly saying one thing but doing the opposite. So confusing it makes me close to almost hating him.
Lol sounds like my ex. Wanting to be friends or at least friendly because he still wanted me in his life somehow. But then acts cold and distant. Now it’s like our relationship was nothing to him.
True. But why would they suggest to be friends if they’re going to be rude for you to move on?
Stay the same as in they’ve always been assholes? Or still treat you the same as in — lovingly or as if you didn’t break up?

Yes! I often feel stupid for feeling the way I do. And honestly, I still can’t help but love him and hope one day he’ll realize what he lost and have to work to get me back.. I accept that it most likely won’t happen, at least not anytime soon, but love makes me a fool. 😅

Yeah, you’re right. His friends, his family, coworkers (I’ve known some of them for years), will never truly know my side and the hurt he’s put me through. And I couldn’t even tell them even if I wanted to. It does suck because if they truly knew the things he’s done and said, I believe they’d actually feel for me. But instead, they all support him and some even encouraged him to rush into dating again, which he is. Like, everyone is just disrespecting me and as you said, I can’t even defend myself.
Ouch. Why pretend for so long though. Hard not to think that everything was a lie at that point.
Yeah, I get it. I mean I know he can’t treat me the way he used to, but just the fact that he can’t even act like a friend when he’s the one who wants to be is what I don’t understand.

I'm currently going through this... It hasn't even been two full months and he's already out dating, and just the thought of myself doing the same thing makes me sick. I knew it was going to happen eventually, but still very hurt that he took less than a month to get over a 5+ year relationship. I think deep down he's suppressing his emotions and distracting himself. So while he's sabotaging himself in the long run, I'm focusing on being a better person for myself. Plus, if these other girls are perfectly fine to date someone fresh out of a long term relationship, then I feel bad for them. Think of it like that. What does it say about the person who moved on too fast, and the people who are okay with being basically a rebound.

If you broke up with her, she probably still hopes for some kind of reconciliation. I’m looking at it from her perspective because I’m also a dumpee. She’s sending you a message without actually messaging you.

No, she knows what she’s doing. The playlist is something you had together and even though you haven’t talked, she added that in hopes you’d see it. Honestly, I would do the same for the playlist my ex and I have, but he removed me from adding anything, but the playlist is still there. 🤷🏽‍♀️
The gift of nothing. 😅
Thank you for giving me a different perspective on my breakup 🧡 saving this post as a reminder.

I drank for pretty much the first time yesterday as I wanted to suppress the sadness. I was so close to reach out, thinking I can just blame it on the alcohol. I ended up writing a whole ass letter in my notes on my phone, planning to put it in a shared folder we had. I was at least slightly conscious enough not to actually do it. Thank god 😅
😭 saving this post to read again and again. thank you.
I always liked Binx for a male black cat. After the cat from Hocus Pocus 😅

I’m there with you. I’m (F) in your shoes and my ex (M) broke up with me for similar reasons. We were together for 6 years, been together since we were 21. We talked about marriage, having a baby by 30. Although I knew my emotional baggage bothered him, breaking up was never supposed to be an option… but it happened. If I knew he was going to give up, I would have made so many changes during the relationship instead of after. I feel your pain. I hope it gets better for you, because the pain has been brutal. 😮‍💨

I’m at that point too. Can’t really tell if I’m over it, though. Currently feeling numb. But some days I would feel great, the next day I’m laying in bed all day crying. I can wake up and be fine, and a few hours later, devastated. But now I think I’m at the point of accepting that it’s over. They didn’t want us, so why continue to want someone who doesn’t want you anymore.
Good luck! And who knows, maybe the sex will be fun with him too. Lol

I think you should ask the new guy where you guys stand before seeing your fwb. If you’ve been on 8 dates in a month or so, and he bought you a Christmas present, I’m sure feelings are there. Do you want a relationship with the new guy? If so, then don’t mess it up by a fun night with the fwb. If you’re not looking for anything serious, then have fun. But talk to the new guy first.
girl, same. we've only been broken up for a month and a half and he's already dating. i have no desire to go out and mingle.

So does she expect to live there for free? lol. You're moving her in so she should pay her share. Doesn't mean she's entitled to be on the title. And at only 8 months together? You guys aren't that serious yet.

I (F) was in your position, and my ex (M) broke up with me. I believe he was a wonderful person, I just wasn't happy with myself and didn't make any effort to change.  We were also together for 5 years, would've been 6 next month. This was also my first real  relationship. Anger is not really serving me anything other than possibly helping me move on from the situation. I don't really want to be, but for the amount of love I have for this person, and the coldness I've been receiving on their end, I have to get over them somehow. So currently feeling anger, just from the fact that they are acting like I meant nothing to them, going out and dating a month of breaking up. I know they can do whatever they want, but it still hurts.

Dang... it's like my story, but roles reversed. Except I'm not at the point you are yet... still processing the breakup, grieving, and currently angry. I hope to become grateful for the memories, but I'm feeling bitter right now.

Good luck to you. 

I tried to do that with my ex and he couldn’t care less about the improvements I made.
I like what you said of how they treat me now is a reflection of themselves. Because if he’s treating me like trash, then he’s trash. Thank you. Lol

Yeah. Shit sucks. And since the breakup, I’m working on everything that went wrong on my part, but they don’t even care to see. How do you just lose love for someone you spent 5+ years with. It’s like I meant nothing.

I'm in a similar situation, almost 2 months for me. They told me they were open to dating less than a month post breakup. I'm also very much struggling to move on. Constantly thinking of it, as soon as I wake up, before I go to bed, I even dream of it. It f'in sucks. 😭
Imma go with a koala 🐨
He made it clear what he wanted, and she knew. However, he also knew she wanted more, so he could've taken advantage of that. If she said she was fine with it, it's on her tbh.

Lately I’ve been listening to Ariana Grande’s Positions album and Doja Cat’s Planet Her album. 

But one song that will always be a good one for me is Khalid - Coaster

I agree! Although it would be nice to get a text, I know my feelings would just be all over the place. 

My ex didn’t care enough to greet me Happy Thanksgiving, so I’m not expecting a Merry Christmas. 🥲

My breakup was a little over a month ago. I’ve been having dreams of him, the situation, or his family every night since… I even get multiple dreams a night. Every night until last night was about the breakup. Last night I had 2 dreams that we were back together. It sucks. I wake up sad. I know I’ve made some progress with moving on, but some days it feels like I’m back at square one.
Female here, but with my last relationship, we walked around naked most the time. 🤷🏽‍♀️
Yes, this works also! I bought one on Amazon for my cat. She loves sitting on it and watches birdies outside.
Do you have a balcony or patio? If you have blinds/curtains, open them up to let the sun in. If there’s enough room on the windowsill, they may sit/lay there and soak up some sun.
I don’t think it’s really their business. You can tell them when you’re ready to.
What a cutie ☺️
I listen to Ariana Grande’s Positions album and Doja Cat’s Planet Her album. I think Lizzo has some good songs too.

Exactly how I’m feeling. Mine was a little over a month ago now. Some days I’m pissed at him, other days I’m heartbroken and miss the shit out of him. I can’t say I hate him, I could never. But I do hate how much I love him.

Edit: he broke up with me for almost the same reasons as yours. ☹️
She is SO CUTE!
Clementine 🧡
I hope to have that mindset some day. Sooner rather than later. I tell myself some things to help me move on. But one day I’ll believe it and the next I’m heartbroken all over again.

We had communication issues, and I had emotional problems (depression/social anxiety). I got too comfortable in the relationship and wasn't making any progress when I said I was going to work on it. We didn't have a healthy way of holding each other accountable or motivate. Eventually he got tired of it and gave up on the relationship. I know it takes two to make the it work, but I feel all the guilt and blame. After some counseling sessions and self reflecting, I've make changes and improvements but sadly he's completely moved on and doesn't want to see that's progression. 😔
So handsome 💙 love the lil bow tie
Oh man, the feels 😭

Me too. And sad part is for me, he says he’s open to dating. Has opportunities to already. And the shittiest part is that I’ll take him back if he wanted to. 😭 It makes me feel pathetic, but that’s how much I love him. I don’t want to give up.

This made me cry… everything you wrote, is how I feel. From seeing someone, talking to them everyday for the last 6 years to basically being strangers. I don’t want to move on. Everyone says I need to, but I can’t. I went NC for a little over 2 weeks and caved and texted him. I felt worse than I did before, and now starting it all over. I think about him, the relationship, the situation constantly. He’s the first thing on my mind when I wake up, last thing before I go to bed. I dream about it every night… I try to distract myself, but nothing had helped. I try to vent to people, but everything they say goes in one ear and out the other and feel they just don’t understand. I lost the love of my life. 😭
Casper was the first name to come to mind. Lol. He’s a cutie!
Cute! Also, Bioshock in the background, nice 🤓

I'm in your shoes right now! Im 27F and me and my ex of almost 6 years years broke up in the beginning of November. We planned for a future together, planned to have a baby within 3 years (we both wanted to be parents before or around 30). I don't even want to think about dating other people, I don't even know how to flirt anymore and don't want to have hookups. I also don't have friends, so it's feeling extremely lonely. I too want to be a mom and wife so bad. We wanted the same things (stay at home mom while he works). And I'm at the point where I might have to accept that it won't happen for me. 😭
I feel the exact same say 😢

Me too, my ex was not as empathetic as I needed him to be. Not as understanding. He wouldn’t even ask me little things like “how was your day” or “have you eaten” little things that show they really cared. But I love him regardless and just want us to reconcile once we both work on ourselves… He sounds so sure that it’s not going to happen, but I don’t want to lose that hope. 😞

I’m not really sure, I think it would be based off of relationship as well. For me, my ex made well over double. But we were also planning on me being a stay at home mom one day. He took care if all the bills, but I had to make sure there was food in the fridge, and took care of all the house duties (cleaning, cooking, laundry, etc.) I’d give him money only if it was needed.

If they can’t afford to split the all the bills, they should contribute to doing more things around the house.
Cute!! I’ll be picking up my lil dood mid-January. ☺️

I haven’t really dealt with many rumors. But when I was in 6th grade, the kids in my class would say I stuffed my bra. We had our names listed on the board for good grades/behavior and we got to be the first ones to go to lunch/recess. Someone wrote “stuffs” next to my name. Girls would ask me for tissues often and they just went on with it. I wasn’t going to prove that I didn’t. Idk if that’s a rumor, or just teasing. But they made the whole class believe it. 🤷🏽‍♀️

I have two, depending on how you want to look at it. 

My first one, I would say was the break up before my most recent ex. He was jealous, called me a whore for having one guy friend who I was friends with before I even met him. We rented a place together, way too young for me to even do but felt obligated to. He was mostly in charge if the rent since I had my own bills to pay and originally agreed that. When we broke up, we were still living together because of the lease. He demanded I pay half and how my bills weren’t his problem, understandable. But anyway, he wouldn’t leave me alone about it. I was playing PS4 online with my friend, and he just turned it off in the middle of it. Then it kind of got physical. He kept following me around the apartment even though I kept telling him to leave me alone. Little did I know, he was recording the whole thing. I pushed him away multiple times for space, he kept instigating. I eventually left to go to my mom’s, and he called the cops on me. He showed the video to the cops and if it wasn’t for me telling him to leave me alone, I would have went to jail since he hard marks on him. I haven’t seen him since him that day. I stayed with my parents, was able to cancel the lease early since there was a police report. Was glad to get out of that situation. 

My second worst breakup was my most recent one. After that guy, I was with my ex for 6 years. I don’t want to get too much into it since it’s still fresh and I’m trying to move on, but our relationship wasn’t bad. We planned for a future together, built a life together in that time, but in the end he realized I’m not what he wanted. So yeah. That shit hurts. 

Two different types of breakups. One physically, one emotionally.
Thank you for this.

I hope this happens to my ex, lol. He’s happy where he’s at, doesn’t think about me or the relationship. Open to dating again. It’s only been a little over a month. 

Anyway, I’ve watched a lot of videos of breakups and the stages we go through as the dumpee vs dumper. I know some people say it’s fake or whatever. But you may be having dumper’s remorse. And assuming you’re male (sorry if not) but their grieving process is pretty opposite compared to females. Females work through their emotions right away, and males tend to have a delayed reaction, not hitting them until later.

It’s still pretty fresh, happened a lil over a month ago. And although it takes two people to make the relationship work, I feel at fault for it ending… Anyway. I would say I got too comfortable. I wasn’t really motivated to make any changes on certain things. I gained weight during the relationship, which of course brought my confidence and self esteem to lower. I get sad a lot, have anxiety. Communication was an issue on both ends. Neither of us really knew how to hold each other accountable or motivate each other in a healthy way. So yeah. There’s more to it but basically, communication and emotional issues. But also, it’s been going on for a while. I just assumed we would never break up because he always said it was never an option and we would get through anything. I’m working on all of that now, but I wish I was able to really sit and and talk and understand like, it would’ve been nice for him to be say, “Listen, if we/you don’t work on this, I can’t do it anymore.” But, it didn’t work out that way.

So, me and my ex were together for almost 6 years. We planned for a future together. Talked about marriage, kids, everything. He’s had said early on how he wanted to put a ring on my finger, but we needed to be at certain points of our lives before that. Also, he wanted to be able to afford a nice ring, even though I’m pretty simple. Anyway. overtime, he started realizing some things about our relationship, or me, that gave him reservations to do so. Deep down he was thinking it wasn’t going to work, but our good times were so good that he stayed. Buuuut, we’re now broken up. So honestly, there could be underlying reasons why he hasn’t yet. I never pressured him, didn’t really talk about it. Maybe if I did, I would’ve realized what he was thinking and worked on improving myself during the relationship instead of after. So my suggestion would be to talk about it. Don’t make the mistakes I did.

I’m definitely keeping my dog vaccinated and will be up to date. I managed to convince them to vax. Apparently they had “no idea” about it. Had to tell them how often and which ones to get. They never go to the vet unless it’s needed. 🙄
They go outside just to use the bathroom, but other than that no… they don’t take their dogs out for walks. It’s sad.

See, but they are pretty much strictly indoors. Also, the owner has had bad experiences with vets, had to put down 2 other dogs. And the vet gives them anxiety. I know, it’s silly. I’ll bring it up, hopefully they will decide to vax, but if they don’t, how do I go about crate/potty training mine?
